features.name: Lexer with mode stack
features.description: Hand-written lexer that tokenizes shell input with context-sensitive modes for quoting (single, double, heredoc, escape), operators, and reserved words. Must handle mode transitions correctly.
notes: 2025-12-11: Workspace setup complete, lexer stub created

features.name: Recursive descent parser
features.description: Parser that builds AST from token stream. Handles simple commands, pipelines, lists (&&, ||, ;, &), compound commands (if/while/for/case), subshells, brace groups, and function definitions.

features.name: Expansion system
features.description: Implement POSIX expansion order: tilde → parameter (all ${} forms) → command substitution → arithmetic → field splitting → pathname/glob → quote removal.

features.name: Simple command execution
features.description: Execute external commands via fork/exec using nix crate. Handle PATH lookup, environment passing, and exit status capture.

features.name: Pipeline execution
features.description: Execute pipelines (cmd1 | cmd2 | cmd3) with proper pipe creation, fd manipulation via dup2, and concurrent process management.

features.name: Redirections
features.description: Implement all POSIX redirections: >, >>, <, >&, N>&M, N<&M. Handle heredocs with delimiter quoting rules.

features.name: Core builtins
features.description: Implement essential builtins that must run in shell process: cd, export, unset, exit, source/., echo, pwd, type, alias, unalias.

features.name: Job control
features.description: Process groups, foreground/background jobs, signal handling (SIGCHLD, SIGINT, SIGTSTP, SIGCONT), job table, fg/bg/jobs/wait builtins.

features.name: OSC 2337 protocol emitter
features.description: Emit custom escape sequences to communicate with colony-terminal: Agent status, Widget requests, Output metadata, Memory operations.

features.name: Tuple space (in-process)
features.description: Linda-style tuple space with out/in/rd/inp/rdp primitives using scc::HashMap and parking_lot for synchronization.

features.name: Tuple space (cross-process IPC)
features.description: Extend tuple space to work across processes via ipc-channel from Servo project.

features.name: Memory substrate (SQLite)
features.description: SQLite schema for memory metadata: scope, project, timestamps, importance, validity. CRUD operations with proper indexing.

features.name: Memory substrate (LanceDB vectors)
features.description: Vector embeddings via LanceDB + fastembed (all-MiniLM-L6-v2). Semantic search over memories with hybrid text+vector queries.

features.name: Agent NL detection and routing
features.description: Detect natural language input (# or ? prefix, failed parse heuristics) and route to LLM instead of shell execution.

features.name: Claude ADK integration
features.description: Connect to Claude API via ADK, handle streaming responses, register MCP tools, manage conversation context.

features.name: MCP connection pool
features.description: Manage connections to multiple MCP servers via rmcp. Introspect tool schemas, handle reconnection.

features.name: MCP TypeScript codegen
features.description: Generate typed TypeScript client classes from MCP server schemas using Tera templates. Cache by schema hash.

features.name: MCP executor session
features.description: Special agent session that receives tasks via tuple space, generates TS scripts, executes in rustyscript sandbox, returns results.

features.name: Goal and task tracking
features.description: Persistent goal trees with status, progress, blockers. Checkpoint creation, session summaries, resume capability.

features.name: .colonyrc configuration
features.description: Project config loading with direnv-style trust model. Agent personality, conventions, project goals, MCP servers.
